decisions.reason: The source specifies the delivery channels for completed clips but does not alter the qualification method, required clip count, success condition, or deadline.
Sending a Google Drive link through project chat enables the existing client audit but does not change approval authority, quota counting, publication eligibility, or rejected-clip handling.
The submission-channel decision does not change the monthly approved-clip count, counting rule, quota period, cadence, or deferred lifecycle status.
The source addresses where clips are submitted for audit and does not change Lead Clipper responsibilities, training, assignment status, or advancement pathway.
The delivery-channel instruction does not modify any clean-editing, visual-effects, or transition standard.
The source changes only how clips are delivered for review and does not modify their required completeness, teaching value, standalone form, or audience comprehension.
The source contains no decision about selecting stronger or more impactful source moments.
Google Drive and Notion are identified as submission channels, not as permitted source-content locations, so the clip source-selection state remains unchanged.
The submission workflow decision does not alter caption color, font, or effects.
The source does not change the required minimum or maximum clip duration.
Submitting clips through Google Drive and project chat for audit is distinct from publishing approved clips, and the source does not change publication eligibility or the Instagram destination.
